verdict.rationale: Forter's fraud automation (webhooks, chargeback forwarding, evidence recommendation, MCP for reviewing decisions/managing disputes) provides background automation of fraud/dispute workflows, and the MCP server lets AI agents trigger actions, but this is not framed as user-configurable 'set up automations that run autonomously' in the sense of scheduled/triggered workflows the AI-native user builds themselves. missing for 10: explicit user-facing automation builder/scheduler, evidence of autonomous background runs initiated by the user rather than reactive webhook/event responses, and independent confirmation of real-world autonomous operation.
